findings.title: IFLEET_DAEMON_TICK_MS parsed with unguarded Number() — NaN coerces to 1ms spin-loop
findings.detail: daemon.ts:275 uses `Number(process.env['IFLEET_DAEMON_TICK_MS'] ?? DEFAULT_TICK_MS)` without a NaN/range guard. When the env var is set to a non-numeric string (e.g. 'abc', '', or an accidentally quoted value), `Number()` returns NaN. Node's `setInterval(fn, NaN)` clamps NaN to 1ms, so the tick loop runs at ~1ms intervals instead of the intended 5000ms, burning 100% CPU and making the daemon unable to process tasks.
findings.fix_sketch: Replace the raw Number() cast with a validated helper: parse to a number, check Number.isFinite and > 0, fall back to DEFAULT_TICK_MS on invalid. Similar to the existing parsePort() pattern in src/utils/env.ts.

findings.title: Stray blank line with trailing spaces inside defaultWarn in candidate-gen.ts
findings.detail: Line 387 of src/agents/proposer/candidate-gen.ts contains a blank line with three trailing spaces inside the `defaultWarn` function body, between the opening brace and `console.warn(line)`. This is noise from an editor auto-indent and inconsistent with the surrounding style.
findings.fix_sketch: Remove the blank line with trailing spaces so the function body is a single `console.warn(line);` statement.

findings.title: Duplicate TODO comment in retro.ts — same deferral expressed twice
findings.detail: src/agents/rituals/retro.ts has two identical TODO lines ('TODO: Move to #ifleet-ops when channel is created.') at lines 12 and 26. Duplicate action items inflate the surface area that future readers scan for outstanding work and can confuse automated TODO-scrapers into counting one action twice.
findings.fix_sketch: Collapse to a single TODO comment at the module level (line 12). Remove the second instance at line 26.
